title: camptorrhiza flexuosa
intro: Camptorrhiza flexuosa, commonly known as 'Red Hot Poker', is a plant species belonging to the Iridaceae family. It is native to South Africa and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Camptorrhiza flexuosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
